1 (Currently Amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a __defined__ compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

3 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit __of a specific dimension__, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches.

7 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against __the same or a different__ tapered fluid conduit.

9 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of __a material selected from the group consisting of__ polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal.

10 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the __defined__ compliant seal.

11 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, __wherein the tapered fluid conduit has a diameter consistent with the fluid passage.__
